scenes.heading: Write an honest comparison of your top products

sents.d: Write an honest comparison of your top products
People comparing two products are close to buying. An honest comparison helps them decide.
Someone weighing two options has already done most of their research.
A fair side by side helps them choose without leaving your page.
Compare price, features and who each product suits best.
Then say clearly which kind of buyer should pick which.

take: A fair side-by-side helps buyers who are almost ready to decide.
